title: The Simple Substitution Key
description:
Forensic Report #104 contains a simple substitution key:
E=X, T=Z, H=Y, O=W, R=V, N=U.
question:
Decode the message:

ZYX WUZV
acceptable_answer_format:
Type the decoded phrase.

Example:
THE ONE
hints: Z -> T, Y -> H, X -> E.
W -> O, U -> N, V -> R (wait: ZYX=THE, WUZV=ONE).
solution_explanation: Substituting characters according to the key (Z->T, Y->H, X->E, W->O, U->N, V->E) yields 'THE ONE'.
